you their mystery. Behold these five kinds:

their hand and their blessing and their joy. This is the first
peace, which the gods and the angels gave to the First
Man as he was coming forth out of the Aeon of Light.

Man at the time when he was going forth to the contest.

The first laying-on-of-hands which the Mother of Life set upon
the head of the First Man — she armed him fully, she girded him
strongly, she laid hands upon him, she set him to the contest. He descended
downward; he completed his battle with the great powers and the en-
-mity.
In these five signs, in these five myster-
-ies the First Man came forth from the aeons of light
against the enemy; he humbled him, he prevailed over them.
The occasion again when he came up out of the war and came in
to the kingdom of the house of the men, in these five myster-
-ies — the peace which he came up in is the peace which the
summoning gave to him when they sent him forth from the Father of Li-

again the very same that he came up in out of the battle. Concerning the my-
